These terms appear in IB Music rubric criteria. Each belongs to one of four achievement levels, and is used in either research/written work, practical work, or both. Understanding them helps you target specific performance bands.

**Abbreviations:** EMC = Exploring Music in Context · EWM = Experimenting with Music · PM = Presenting Music · CMM = The Contemporary Music Maker

## Level 1: Uninformed Imitation

```{=html}
<div class="rt-level-desc">
  <strong>Description</strong>
  The student replicates existing material without direction or sense of purpose; musical material is taken out of context or misrepresented.
  <div class="rt-chars"><strong>Possible characteristics:</strong> Ineffective · Inaccurate · Rudimentary · Limited · Superficial</div>
</div>

<table class="rt-table rt-level-1">
  <thead>
    <tr><th style="width:16%">Term</th><th style="width:20%">Type</th><th style="width:22%">Used in</th><th>Definition</th></tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr id="rt-list">
      <td>List</td>
      <td>Research/Written</td>
      <td>EMC B1</td>
      <td>Give a sequence of brief answers with no explanation.</td>
    </tr>
    <tr id="rt-outline">
      <td>Outline</td>
      <td>Research/Written</td>
      <td>EMC B2, EWM A, EWM C, PM A, CMM B</td>
      <td>Give a brief account or summary.</td>
    </tr>
    <tr id="rt-identify">
      <td>Identify</td>
      <td>Research/Written</td>
      <td>CMM B</td>
      <td>Provide an answer from a number of possibilities.</td>
    </tr>
    <tr id="rt-assemble">
      <td>Assemble</td>
      <td>Practical</td>
      <td>—</td>
      <td>Combine or gather pre-existing material without change.</td>
    </tr>
    <tr id="rt-approximate">
      <td>Approximate</td>
      <td>Practical</td>
      <td>EMC C1, PM B, PM C, CMM C</td>
      <td>Imitate with lack of detail.</td>
    </tr>
    <tr id="rt-reiterate">
      <td>Reiterate</td>
      <td>Practical</td>
      <td>EWM B, EWM D</td>
      <td>Repeat or restate, largely without change.</td>
    </tr>
  </tbody>
</table>
```

## Level 2: Precise Imitation

```{=html}
<div class="rt-level-desc">
  <strong>Description</strong>
  The work constructs a recognizable original or rearranges existing material. The work is technically accurate but lacks evidence of personal musical choices.
  <div class="rt-chars"><strong>Possible characteristics:</strong> Inconsistent · Formulaic · Sufficient · Suitable · Reasonable</div>
</div>

<table class="rt-table rt-level-2">
  <thead>
    <tr><th style="width:16%">Term</th><th style="width:20%">Type</th><th style="width:22%">Used in</th><th>Definition</th></tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr id="rt-describe">
      <td>Describe</td>
      <td>Research/Written</td>
      <td>EMC B1, EMC B2, EWM A, EWM C, PM A, CMM B</td>
      <td>Give a detailed account.</td>
    </tr>
    <tr id="rt-demonstrate">
      <td>Demonstrate</td>
      <td>Research/Written</td>
      <td>CMM B</td>
      <td>Make clear by reasoning or evidence, illustrating with examples or practical application.</td>
    </tr>
    <tr id="rt-distinguish">
      <td>Distinguish</td>
      <td>Research/Written</td>
      <td>CMM B</td>
      <td>Make clear the differences between two or more concepts or items.</td>
    </tr>
    <tr id="rt-exhibit">
      <td>Exhibit</td>
      <td>Practical</td>
      <td>EMC C1, PM B</td>
      <td>Demonstrate a characteristic in the appropriate context.</td>
    </tr>
    <tr id="rt-transmit">
      <td>Transmit</td>
      <td>Practical</td>
      <td>EMC C2, PM C, CMM C</td>
      <td>Give a formulaic rendition of an existing work or style.</td>
    </tr>
    <tr id="rt-recreate">
      <td>Recreate</td>
      <td>Practical</td>
      <td>EWM B, EWM D</td>
      <td>Produce a representation of an original.</td>
    </tr>
  </tbody>
</table>
```

## Level 3: Informed Proficiency

```{=html}
<div class="rt-level-desc">
  <strong>Description</strong>
  The student's work is technically proficient and realizes musical conventions and practices. The student adapts material and makes informed technical choices.
  <div class="rt-chars"><strong>Possible characteristics:</strong> Accurate · Proficient · Purposeful · Relevant · Competent</div>
</div>

<table class="rt-table rt-level-3">
  <thead>
    <tr><th style="width:16%">Term</th><th style="width:20%">Type</th><th style="width:22%">Used in</th><th>Definition</th></tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr id="rt-explain">
      <td>Explain</td>
      <td>Research/Written</td>
      <td>EMC B1, EMC B2, EWM A, EWM C, PM A, CMM B</td>
      <td>Give a detailed account, including reasons or causes.</td>
    </tr>
    <tr id="rt-investigate">
      <td>Investigate</td>
      <td>Research/Written</td>
      <td>CMM B</td>
      <td>Observe, study, or make a detailed and systematic examination in order to establish facts and reach new conclusions.</td>
    </tr>
    <tr id="rt-justify">
      <td>Justify</td>
      <td>Research/Written</td>
      <td>CMM B</td>
      <td>Give valid reasons or evidence to support an answer or conclusion.</td>
    </tr>
    <tr id="rt-realize">
      <td>Realize</td>
      <td>Practical</td>
      <td>EMC C1, PM B, CMM C</td>
      <td>Plan and create a work according to convention or practice.</td>
    </tr>
    <tr id="rt-shape">
      <td>Shape</td>
      <td>Practical</td>
      <td>EMC C2, PM C</td>
      <td>Modify and develop existing material.</td>
    </tr>
    <tr id="rt-adapt">
      <td>Adapt</td>
      <td>Practical</td>
      <td>EWM B, EWM D</td>
      <td>Adjust existing material to suit a new context or style.</td>
    </tr>
  </tbody>
</table>
```

## Level 4: Mastery and Resourcefulness

```{=html}
<div class="rt-level-desc">
  <strong>Description</strong>
  The student's musical work expresses a distinctive, personal voice manifested through technical and musical accomplishment.
  <div class="rt-chars"><strong>Possible characteristics:</strong> Imaginative · Resourceful · Compelling · Accomplished · Excellent</div>
</div>

<table class="rt-table rt-level-4">
  <thead>
    <tr><th style="width:16%">Term</th><th style="width:20%">Type</th><th style="width:22%">Used in</th><th>Definition</th></tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr id="rt-discuss">
      <td>Discuss</td>
      <td>Research/Written</td>
      <td>CMM B</td>
      <td>Offer a considered and balanced review supported by appropriate evidence.</td>
    </tr>
    <tr id="rt-examine">
      <td>Examine</td>
      <td>Research/Written</td>
      <td>CMM B</td>
      <td>Consider an argument or concept in a way that uncovers the assumptions and interrelationships of the issue.</td>
    </tr>
    <tr id="rt-evaluate">
      <td>Evaluate</td>
      <td>Research/Written</td>
      <td>EWM A, EWM C, CMM B</td>
      <td>Make an appraisal by weighing up the strengths and limitations.</td>
    </tr>
    <tr id="rt-personalize">
      <td>Personalize</td>
      <td>Practical</td>
      <td>PM C, CMM C</td>
      <td>Bring personal ideas and interpretations to a work or practice.</td>
    </tr>
    <tr id="rt-synthesize">
      <td>Synthesize</td>
      <td>Practical</td>
      <td>PM B</td>
      <td>Combine and blend existing elements, styles, or techniques to create new work.</td>
    </tr>
    <tr id="rt-transform">
      <td>Transform</td>
      <td>Practical</td>
      <td>EWM B, EWM D</td>
      <td>Change and develop existing work to create new work.</td>
    </tr>
  </tbody>
</table>
```
